name: Jun
source:
Akira's younger brother, and someone who Izumi hits it off with. Also a source of distrust with the player's boyfriend, and later Hiroshi.

[spoiler]Midway through the story, both he and Izumi go missing. Both are found with each other following a series of romantic incidents. He ends up as Izumi's boyfriend.[/spoiler]
